windows.mode: Activate the existing project-scoped toolchain environment in each new PowerShell session.
windows.scope: Toolchain storage belongs to the Woah workspace. Existing global Rust installations for other projects are separate.

mac.mode: Fresh zsh/bash login shells load the existing installation through ~/.cargo/env. Non-login runners may source that file explicitly.
mac.repo_doctor: passed in new zsh login shell
mac.scope: Reuses the existing toolchain in woah-rust-tools. Startup configuration only; compiled native binaries and repository inputs unchanged.
